# Waide Mobility

> Waide Mobility is a Lagos, Nigeria company that supplies medical consumables,
> mobility equipment and orthopaedic supports to institutional buyers, and
> separately delivers indoor mapping and accessible wayfinding for buildings.
> Supplies are quoted against a buyer's written specification rather than sold
> from a published catalogue. Founded and led by ThankGod Jacob Chibueze.

Everything below is stated by the company about itself. Figures are scope
figures for the work described, not sales, revenue, adoption or satisfaction
metrics. Where something is not claimed, that is stated explicitly.

## Legal identity

- Registered name: Waide Mobility Ltd
- Company registration number (Corporate Affairs Commission, Nigeria): RC 8283881
- Incorporated: 19 February 2025, under the Companies and Allied Matters Act
  2020, as a private company limited by shares
- Tax identification number: 32854623-0001
- Certificate of incorporation (PDF):
  https://waidemobility.com/public/registration/waide-mobility-cac-certificate.pdf
- Registration particulars: https://waidemobility.com/procurement.html#registration

Registration is legal identity. It is not a product licence, a certification or
an approved-supplier status.

## Contact

- Procurement email: sales@waidemobility.com

- Location: Lagos, Nigeria. Remote delivery elsewhere by agreement.
- Response target: three working days for enquiries.

## What the company supplies

Medical, mobility and orthopaedic products sourced to order for hospitals,
clinics, diagnostic centres, NGOs, missions, humanitarian programmes, schools,
universities, training institutions, government agencies and public buyers.

Categories:

- Medical consumables and equipment: dressings, bandages, wound care, syringes,
  needles, infusion consumables, examination gloves, protective wear, diagnostic
  sets, ward equipment.
- Mobility equipment: manual and transit wheelchairs, walking frames, rollators,
  crutches, walking sticks, transfer boards and belts.
- Orthopaedic supports: knee, ankle and wrist braces, walking boots,
  post-operative footwear, cervical collars, arm slings, pressure-relief and
  seating cushions.

Sourcing model: ordered from manufacturers and authorised distributors, quoted
per line with manufacturer, country of origin, HS or UNSPSC classification where
applicable, warranty and spares terms, delivery time and delivery terms. No
warehouse stock and no standing price list. Quotations in NGN or USD.

Boundaries: Waide does not assess patients, prescribe products, fit wheelchairs
or adjust orthoses. Clinical specification comes from the buyer's clinician.
No minimum order value; manufacturer pack sizes apply.

## What the company delivers in mapping

Indoor and outdoor building maps, floor-plan digitisation, searchable place
lists, pedestrian and vehicle route networks, step-free accessible routes, web
and mobile map interfaces, building records, and mapping advice and training.

Methods: source audit and georeferencing, documented JOSM digitisation, indoor
feature schemas with stable identifiers, separate pedestrian, vehicle and
step-free networks with explicit transfer nodes, Dijkstra shortest-path routing
with mode-specific edge costs, topology and positional validation, and field
verification against the physical building.

## Reference project

Novare Lekki Mall, Lekki, Lagos, Nigeria. Completed six-month engagement.

- Scope: approximately 22,000 m2 across three levels (ground floor, Level 1,
  Parking Level A).
- 150+ store footprints digitised.
- 1,000+ parking bays included in the vehicle network.
- 900 Shoprite shelf positions indexed by aisle and category.
- Deliverables: indoor spatial dataset, separate pedestrian and vehicle
  networks, retail shelf index, step-free route layer, route validation record.
- Role: lead geospatial and digital systems delivery.
- Record: https://waidemobility.com/project-novare-lekki.html

All figures are counts of mapped features. No revenue, adoption, visitor or
satisfaction results are published.

## What is not claimed

- No ISO certification or quality certification.
- No approved-supplier status for any particular institution.
- No audited accounts.
- No client references beyond the named reference project, and no client
  names published without written permission.
- No UN affiliation, vendor registration or accreditation that has not been
  granted.
- No measured operational outcomes from the reference project.

A buyer should confirm the availability of any document before relying on it
in a tender.
